# ITEMS — item-type table, item-name words, item inventory (generated by decode/tools/items.py md)

Record layouts and code evidence: [SAVES.md](SAVES.md) §4 (63-byte item) and §6 (ITEMS file). ITEMS (2050 B) is read by ov11_002D with Seek(2) + BlockRead(2048) into DS:5582: type t = file[2+16t .. 17+16t]. Columns j0..j15 as in SAVES.md §6 (slot, hands, dice/sides/bonus vs large, rof, ac_value, wflags, j8, dice/sides/bonus vs S/M, range, usable_by (class mask: 1 MU, 2 cleric, 4 thief, 8 fighter), wflags2, j15).

"Seen as" = names of real item records (saves, MONnITM, ITEMn) with this type, built like FUN_00BA_0442 (identified).

Base weapons and armour use the word with their own type number (types 1..47, 50..59); words 48 "Mail" and 49 "Armor" are suffixes (Banded Mail = words 39h + 30h, Leather Armor = 32h + 31h) and types 48/49 are empty. Magic items combine words, e.g. "Long Sword +1" = +31h 24h (Long Sword), +30h A2h (+1), +2Fh 00h. j0 values >= 0Ah other than the scroll/ring/ammo ones (4Ah, 4Bh, 4Dh, 4Eh …) are never < 9 or = 9, so these types cannot be readied into a body slot (Recalc).
